title: Tube to Plate Viral Media Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: 1-4 repeated by row in the tube racks.

steps.title: Configure pipette and deck
steps.instruction: Place three tube racks in slots 1, 4, and 7 and load a 96‑well plate. Set the number of samples for the run, set tube aspiration height to 1 mm, well dispense height to 1 mm, aspirate/dispense flow rate to 274 µL/s, and mount the P1000 single‑channel pipette on the required (left or right) mount.

steps.title: Transfer VTM from tube to well
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip, aspirate 200 µL of viral transport media (VTM) from the current tube and dispense the 200 µL into the corresponding well of the 96‑well plate, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 200 µL of VTM from the tube (row‑wise).
Dispense 200 µL of VTM into the matching well.

steps.title: Repeat transfer for all rows
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer step for each row across the three tube racks (rack 1 slot 1, rack 2 slot 4, rack 3 slot 7) until all up to 96 samples have been reformatted into the 96‑well plate.
